horoscope: Your belief in yourself and others is admirable today, dear Aries. Putting more faith in the people you love and showing your appreciation can strengthen a bond or open opportunities to connect with someone new. Sharing your happiness with someone can take a relationship to a new level, and people are drawn to your good humor. Honesty and openness become you! There is also good energy for taking care of yourself emotionally. The Moon spends the day in your protective solar fourth house, stirring your needs for safety, security, and familiarity. It's an excellent time for introspection.

There's a forgiving and generous theme to the day, dear Taurus. It's a strong time for enjoying your daily life, work, duties, and family. A pleasing level of cooperation surrounds your interactions. Emotional clarity creates positive energy today. Your passion and good sense show through in your work, the services you provide, or your domestic pursuits and home-related projects. It's a beautiful time to put your faith in someone you love and let them know. Your positivity certainly helps attract support and warmth from others. Self-expression comes especially easily today, boosting social events or rapport with others. It makes sense to let your curious and optimistic spirit guide your day.

Transits strengthen, motivate, and support your efforts today, dear Gemini, especially to get along with others. There can be happy feedback for your work, ideas, or creativity. An open, generous, and forthcoming attitude is your best bet, and is also very attractive now. You may be feeling lucky in love or particularly pleased with your current interests and projects. It's also a strong day for communicating rationally, readily, and naturally about health, career, and work. It's a time for grounding yourself. Today is excellent for giving thought to how you can improve your work or income, and conversations about your practical affairs or the information you come across now can be helpful along these lines.

Transits today help you see the bright side of a situation, dear Cancer. The desire to share your happiness and good fortune with someone is strong. Generous feelings can inspire you to make a nice gesture to someone special in your life. You can stumble upon a good buy or enjoy taking special care of a prized belonging. Today is also strong for connecting with others, especially with people you love. With the Moon in your sign, you can feel a strong need for self-nurturing.

Transits today support relaxing, enjoying yourself, and letting things run their natural course, dear Leo. You project confidence, positivity, optimism, and generosity. You're generous with your time and understanding right now, and this can make a world of difference in both your personal and professional lives. Jupiter is in your own sign, and it's harmonizing with Venus in your communications sector, making your messages well received. Even small gestures made now can have an incredible impact. You may very well benefit from a bit of pampering now. Problem-solving comes so naturally today that you might find you're quickly and easily fixing things that previously stumped you.

You're in good shape for spreading some cheer today, dear Virgo, and you're likely to enjoy the spirit of understanding, tolerance, and support. It can be a time for healing, forgiving, or taking a relationship to a new level. It's a great time to give someone the benefit of the doubt. Confidence in your worth and value can attract positive attention, and perhaps even a bonus or recognition. Relationships and practical matters are both in good form now. Your gentler qualities are subtly enhanced and more noticeable today, and it's also a good time for conversations revolving around your personal interests and causes. There can be an active interest in learning new things and connecting with others.

There is positive, playful energy with you today, dear Libra, and it's a potentially excellent time for relations with friends. Instead, you could be feeling particularly confident about your plans and projects. Your ideas excite and motivate you, and you're received well, perhaps also admired for your personal style. Venus in your sign highlights your attractive qualities, and it's heading toward harmony with Jupiter. You may focus on a direction that motivates you, and you enjoy solving problems or simply looking beyond flaws and challenges to the good times ahead. With the Moon at the top of your chart, you too feel the urge to reach greater heights. You may notice more eyes on you than usual, which can motivate you to do your best or put more effort into what you're doing.

Enthusiasm is in large supply today, dear Scorpio, and staying open, honest, and generous can be the perfect strategy or approach with current transits. You can take real pleasure in setting goals for yourself and basking in the confidence that you'll reach them in due time. A private or anonymous act of kindness might lift your spirits, or you may come to a new understanding of a past matter that helps you move forward more confidently. Working behind the scenes can be especially rewarding now. You're also likely to feel entirely at ease expressing both your ideas and feelings. The Moon's transit through your sector of adventure and higher learning helps lift your spirits as you rise above the regular stresses and problems of daily life.

Today's transits support beautiful connections or a bond with a friend through shared ideas and beliefs, dear Sagittarius. Instead, you can enjoy great enthusiasm and excitement about a current project. Your sense of community is strong, and emotional satisfaction can come through your interactions with friends and associates. Matters related to team efforts, business income, publishing, promotion, and education are favored for you right now.  It can also be a strong time to talk over strategies regarding managing your money and family matters. Taking care of business in general is supported now, as your mind is all set to do so.

You can feel valued and respected today, dear Capricorn, and it encourages and motivates you. It's a good time for attracting who or what you want. You see the worth and value of things more clearly, professionally, practically, and personally, which leads to sensible decisions. While you may have felt that things were up in the air recently, today you're either accepting the idea or looking forward to new directions. Finding the right answers comes more quickly today than it might on another day. An easy, natural energy runs through much of the day, with fluidity between your feelings and intellect, and you may find it easy to communicate on both levels. It's an excellent time to correct problems in relationships and to iron out differences.

Today's energies are good for an open and optimistic attitude that helps attract positive attention, dear Aquarius. It's a good time to circulate, connect, collaborate, and share. In fact, sharing ideas and beliefs can boost a relationship. You might bond with someone as you try harder to understand them. Be generous and forthcoming for best results today. The tendency is to talk comfortably and naturally about matters that previously were hidden or too private to discuss. The Moon spends the day in your sector of routine, habits, health, and work, and there can be a stronger focus on service or organization than usual. Conversations can lead to new ideas or methods of getting things done that are empowering.

Your thinking is optimistic today, dear Pisces. People are especially cooperative when you give them the benefit of the doubt, so it's easy to pick yourself back up if something doesn't pan out exactly as you expected. Appreciation may be forthcoming now. There can be positive feelings about work projects or investments, and your intimate life can get a boost. Ideally, you're able to feel close to someone but also free to be yourself or to express some independence. It's a good day for forgiveness and understanding, as well as problem-solving. Your ideas — and sense of fun — are big and prominent today. You have a greater need for recreation and leisure than usual.
